"""Provide the disposable D46 stable-id-order utility fixture."""

import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def deduplicate_ids(values):
    """Return unique identifiers in their first-occurrence order without mutating input."""
    logger.info("d46_fixture_call case=stable-id-order")
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for value in values:
        if value not in seen:
            seen.add(value)
            result.append(value)
    return result

import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def parse_bool(value):
    """Parse explicit trimmed boolean text and reject unsupported values."""
    logger.info("d46_fixture_call case=explicit-boolean-text")
    normalized = value.strip().casefold()
    if normalized in {"true", "yes", "1", "on"}:
        return True
    if normalized in {"false", "no", "0", "off"}:
        return False
    raise ValueError("unsupported boolean text")
